title: Dictionary Management (3 Stages)
description:
Practice dictionary operations across 3 stages:
1. Create dictionary user = {"name": "Alex", "level": 5} and print user["name"].
2. Update user["level"] = 6 and print user["level"].
3. Add user["role"] = "admin" and print user.get("role").
